LanguageData.CPG.AdvancedMode.Description: Shows individual settings for each race.\nDisabling this does not prevent race-specific options (see "Use Race Specific Options".)
LanguageData.CPG.ResetAll.Description: This will restore all the default values of the settings of each race (including [Global Config]) and cannot be undone.\nAre you sure?
LanguageData.CPG.UseRaceSpecific.Description: If enabled, race-specific options will be used (disabling the "Advanced Settings" does not prevent this.)
LanguageData.CPG.CustomAging.Description:
When enabled, allows pawns to have a custom aging speed (in game ticks.)
This option may slow down your game significiantly, particularly on larger colonies.
This does not affect other age-related options.

Requires a restart to take effect.
LanguageData.CPG.GlobalConfig.Description: All races that do not have any modified settings or uses the [Use Global Config] option will refer to this instead.\nSome options will only be applied when necessary (body types for humanoid races only, etc.)
LanguageData.CPG.UngenderedParent.Description:
When enabled, all pawns can either be a mother or father, regardless of gender.
Some have reported this to cause lag, possibly from a mod incompatibility.
If this causes lag for you, please disable this.

Requires a restart to take effect.
